ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 18, Compton-Getting corrected, Survival Probability corrected, ANTIRAM West Ecliptic ENA Maps, Level H3, fourteen-year average Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and checked for SPASE 2.7.2 structural and semantic consistency, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 18 fourteen-year combined hydrogen energetic neutral atom (ENA) maps from antiram-direction observations, in Solar Ecliptic coordinates using West Ecliptic longitude. Compton-Getting correction has been applied to the flux spectra to account for spacecraft motion relative to the arriving ENAs. Survival-probability correction has been applied to account for ENA ionization losses during propagation and to scale the fluxes from the IBEX observing location near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU. The source metadata identifies the combined 2009-2022 product and gives measurement boundaries of 2008-12-25 through 2022-12-26. The product contains one combined map per energy channel, not a sequence of annual maps. Each map has 60 longitude bins by 30 latitude bins at six-degree spacing. The nominal energies of IBEX-Hi channels 2-6 are 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV; the corresponding instrument FWHM ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV. These nominal energies and FWHM ranges characterize the instrument channels; Ener2-Ener6 provide the mapped energies for individual pixels. The parameters include mapped energy, differential flux, signal-to-noise ratio, flux variance, total counts, total exposure time, and samples per pixel averaged over the measurement interval, together with time, map, coordinate, and orbit support variables and CDAWeb *_plasma X/Y alternate views. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R18_CG_SP_ANTIRAM_14YR.
